record.question: For a standard 450 mL bold donation, what is the volume of CPD anticoagulant added to the collection bag?
record.explanation: Answer C: 63mL. A standard 450 mL CPD collection set contains approximately 63 mL anticoagulant, corresponding to the established collection ratio. Reference: https://www.fda.gov/media/70807/download; https://www.dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/getFile.cfm?setid=d763511e-f1a7-4014-94b9-f7ad8f023ff4&type=pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
